items.title: 16.2 Laboratory mein khatraat ki aam qismein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.2, printed page 337.

blocks.text: Laboratory mein kaam karte hue samne aane wale zyada tar khatraat (hazards) teen qismon mein aate hain: physical, kimiyai (chemical) aur hayatiyati (biological) khatraat. Har ek agle teen topics mein bayan hai.

blocks.caption: Teen qismein
rows: geele farsh par phisalna aur girna; toote sheeshe se kat jana
har chemical ke khaas khatraat, us ke standard procedure se sambhale hue
allergens; janwaron se insanon ko muntaqil hone wali mutaddi bimariyan; viral bimariyan

blocks.prompt: Inhen qismon mein rakhein: tarakh wala beaker, ghaliz acid ki botal, phaphoondi (mould) ki culture (Quick Check 16.1a; exercise Q.3).
blocks.explanation: Tarakh wala beaker physical khatra hai (kat jana); ghaliz acid chemical khatra hai (jalna, dhuan); mould culture biological khatra hai (allergens, infection).

items: Laboratory ke khatraat: physical, chemical aur biological.
